title: Witness the tau-minimiser and its uniform subgroup for the entropic PFR conjecture
intent: Prove the entropic PFR conjecture (for two G-valued random variables there is a subgroup H and uniform U_H with both Ruzsa distances to U_H at most 6·d and their sum at most 11·d) by obtaining a tau-minimiser as a witness, turning its zero Ruzsa distance into a uniform subgroup, and closing the three distance bounds with the triangle inequality plus linarith.

parent.name: entropic_PFR_conjecture
parent.statement:
theorem entropic_PFR_conjecture (hpη : p.η = 1 / 9) :
    ∃ H : Submodule (ZMod 2) G, ∃ Ω : Type uG, ∃ mΩ : MeasureSpace Ω, ∃ U : Ω → G,
    IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω) ∧ Measurable U ∧
    IsUniform H U ∧ d[p.X₀₁ # U] + d[p.X₀₂ # U] ≤ 11 * d[p.X₀₁ # p.X₀₂] ∧
      d[p.X₀₁ # U] ≤ 6 * d[p.X₀₁ # p.X₀₂] ∧
      d[p.X₀₂ # U] ≤ 6 * d[p.X₀₁ # p.X₀₂]

children.name: tau_minimizer_exists
children.statement:
lemma tau_minimizer_exists [MeasurableSingletonClass G] :
    ∃ (Ω : Type uG) (_ : MeasureSpace Ω) (X₁ : Ω → G) (X₂ : Ω → G),
    Measurable X₁ ∧ Measurable X₂ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω) ∧
    TauMinimizes p X₁ X₂
children.closed_by: tau_min_exists_measure p (compactness of the probability-measure pair via IsCompact.exists_isMinOn), lifted to random variables with IdentDistrib.tau_eq and Prod.fst / Prod.snd on G × G

children.name: tau_strictly_decreases
children.statement:
theorem tau_strictly_decreases (h_min : TauMinimizes p X₁ X₂) (hpη : p.η = 1 / 9) :
    d[X₁ # X₂] = 0
children.closed_by: transfers to independent copies via independent_copies4_nondep and IdentDistrib.rdist_congr / IdentDistrib.tauMinimizes, then `apply tau_strictly_decreases_aux`

children.name: exists_isUniform_of_rdist_eq_zero
children.statement:
theorem exists_isUniform_of_rdist_eq_zero
    {Ω' : Type*} [MeasureSpace Ω'] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω')] {X' : Ω' → G}
    (hX : Measurable X) (hX' : Measurable X') (hdist : d[X # X'] = 0) :
    ∃ H : AddSubgroup G, ∃ U : Ω → G,
      Measurable U ∧ IsUniform H U ∧ d[X # U] = 0 ∧ d[X' # U] = 0
children.closed_by: derives d[X # X] = 0 from rdist_triangle and rdist_symm, then rcases exists_isUniform_of_rdist_self_eq_zero and closes d[X' # U] = 0 by rdist_triangle again

children.name: rdist_symm
children.statement:
lemma rdist_symm [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure μ'] :
    d[X ; μ # Y ; μ'] = d[Y ; μ' # X ; μ]
children.closed_by: rw [rdist_def, rdist_def, sub_sub, sub_sub, add_comm], then entropy_neg and prod_swap

children.name: is_tau_min
children.statement:
lemma is_tau_min (h : TauMinimizes p X₁ X₂) (h1 : Measurable X₁') (h2 : Measurable X₂') :
    τ[X₁ # X₂ | p] ≤ τ[X₁' # X₂' | p]
children.closed_by: push-forwards X₁' and X₂' to measures ν₁, ν₂ and rewrites via identDistrib_id_right .. tau_eq, then `convert h ν₁ ν₂`

children.name: rdist_triangle
children.statement:
lemma rdist_triangle {X : Ω → G} {Y : Ω' → G} {Z : Ω'' → G}
    (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y) (hZ : Measurable Z)
    [hμ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [hμ' : IsProbabilityMeasure μ']
    [hμ'' : IsProbabilityMeasure μ''] [FiniteRange X] [FiniteRange Y] [FiniteRange Z] :
    d[X ; μ # Z ; μ''] ≤ d[X ; μ # Y ; μ'] + d[Y ; μ' # Z ; μ'']
children.closed_by: reduces to independent copies via independent_copies3_nondep_finiteRange, then a calc chain through ent_of_diff_le and IndepFun.rdist_eq

applicability.goal_shape: an existence goal ∃ H … , ∃ U …, IsUniform H U ∧ P₁ U ∧ P₂ U ∧ P₃ U whose witness is supplied by an existence lemma (a minimiser, a zero-distance object) and whose properties are distance/functional inequalities
applicability.use_when: the object to exhibit is defined by an optimisation (a τ-minimiser here) or a zero-distance condition, and every remaining property of the witness follows from generic facts (a triangle inequality, a minimiser comparison) closed by linear arithmetic
applicability.avoid_when: the witness's properties need a bespoke construction or a long case analysis instead of generic distance facts; or the existence lemma is the whole content rather than a building block; or a property needs the witness's internal structure, which must then come back through a lemma such as is_tau_min

claims.claim: The glue of entropic_PFR_conjecture (PFR/EntropyPFR.lean lines 60-73) invokes six named lemmas — tau_minimizer_exists, tau_strictly_decreases, exists_isUniform_of_rdist_eq_zero, rdist_symm, is_tau_min, and rdist_triangle (four times) — and closes the three target distance bounds by linarith alone.

claims.claim: The authors state that exists_isUniform_of_rdist_eq_zero "Follows from the preceding claim by the triangle inequality", and the proof realises that with two rdist_triangle steps plus rdist_symm.

The decomposition is flat and short: the parent proof is 14 lines (60-73); its six direct-lemma children have proof lengths 10, 9, 11, 6, 5 and 18 lines (tau_minimizer_exists, tau_strictly_decreases, exists_isUniform_of_rdist_eq_zero, rdist_symm, is_tau_min, rdist_triangle); the longest project-lemma chain I checked below the theorem has depth 3 (entropic_PFR_conjecture → tau_strictly_decreases → tau_strictly_decreases_aux → first_estimate).

claims.claim: The same witness assembly is repeated for the improved conjecture: entropic_PFR_conjecture_improv obtains a minimiser, turns d = 0 into H and U via exists_isUniform_of_rdist_eq_zero, compares via is_tau_min, and closes by rdist_triangle and linarith.

metrics.how_counted: parent proof = PFR/EntropyPFR.lean lines 60-73; children = the six named lemmas invoked in the glue, in glue order; each child closes by named lemmas or rw/calc, none by a single automation tactic alone

consequences: The move turns one ∃-goal into an obtain of the witness followed by a set of property goals for that witness, each discharged by one named lemma. Obligations: the existence lemma must be available under the ambient hypotheses (here nonempty_fintype G and the refPackage p, plus MeasurableSingletonClass G); the three distance bounds must follow from the obtained facts plus generic distance lemmas, so if a property needs the witness's internal structure it must return through a lemma such as is_tau_min. Failure mode: if any property is not derivable from rdist_triangle/linarith, the witness itself has to be unfolded and the clean one-lemma-per-goal shape breaks.
